programme.desc: Tim goes in search of a long since lost species of frog in Queensland as he discovers just how important amphibians are to the survival of the planet.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim heads to South Australia to meet the fascinating pygmy blue tongue lizard. Once thought extinct, it’s now a race against time to make sure the existing population survive.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim visits the Kimberley to witness one of natures most astounding events, discovers some subterranean hideouts, and takes Tasmanian devils to Sydney University in the quest to find a cure for a disease that threatens the species.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim travels far out west to Broome to help an old mate move a 5 metre saltwater croc to its new home. Back on the east coast Tim witnesses one of nature’s greatest sights: turtle hatchlings making their way into the sea for the first time.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: In Episode 1 Nicky explores the spectacular Blue Mountains, Andrew gets down to the nitty gritty of car collecting, Snowy shows us his amazing Snowy burger. And introducing Dr. Mel and the wild and wacky world of fly ball.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: Nicky visits Bruny Island off the coast of Tasmania, Snowy shows us his authentic home style fish curry, we discover the perfect backyard garden, when you don’t actually have a back yard, and gold fever as Andrew gets the prospecting bug.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: In episode 3, the story behind some stunning quilts, the rock star spreading a heart felt message, Snowy shows us how to make cheese at home, and meet a group of women in whose case countless stitches are saving many very special lives.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: Nicky is in Wilpena Pound for an aerial flight over Lake Eyre, Andrew meets the clown doctors who dish out the best medicine of all, Snowy's recipe for a delectable mousse, and Shawy scales new heights as he explores high-rise gardens.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: We visit The Valley of The Kings where many of the Egyptian Pharaohs and their magnificent treasures were buried, Andrew has a heart-stopping adventure, and Dr Mel tackles some common myths and misconceptions about pets.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: In episode 6 Nicky is cruisin’ down the River Nile, Snowy shows us an exotic Vietnamese steamboat, and Dr Caroline tackles her fear of heights.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: in episode 7 Nicky is down at Hobart’s famous weekly Salamanca Market, Coxy joins us as special guest presenter, Snowy shares his nutty recipe for the perfect pasta and Tony shows us a gorilla-proof garden.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: In episode 8 Nicky visits the famed domes of the Bungle Bungle Range, Andrew brews up a storm with a few mates, Snowy shows us a fragrant red beef curry and we talk to Doctor Caroline on why being happy can keep us healthy.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: Sun, sand and sea … this is one spot you’ll definitely want to visit. Also this episode, Nicky finds out how to bring our wardrobes to life, and it’s back to school for Doctor Mel as she meets some dedicated two and four-legged volunteers.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: In episode 10, Coxy puts his hand up to go to Canada and can’t wait to show you around. Also this week Snowy’s super easy and hearty Brazilian bean soup and the benefits of weight training at any age.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: Andrew explores a beautiful seaside town with a feast of things to see and do, Snowy transforms humble rhubarb into an amazing desert, we look at uncovering the secrets of your family tree, and how to turn your garden into an edible oasis.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: Andrew helps out an inspiring group of volunteers helping flood victims rebuild fences, Coxy explores Oslo, the home of the mighty Vikings. Also, Snowy whips up a fantastic seafood risotto, and Dr. Mel on the joys of adopting a new pet.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Guide to the Goodlife, Nicky is at Emma Gorge in the Kimberley. Andrew tests his driving skills, and Snowy dazzles us with his zucchini flowers and lemon risotto.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: Paul visits the famous Hunter Valley wine region, serving up snails and Australia’s fresh water crayfish, the yabby, cooked with the Hunter’s local brews.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: Paul finds foodie paradise on the little known Fleurieu Peninsula south of Adelaide, offering wine, wildlife and water in abundance.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: Paul travels to southern Tasmania to savour oysters straight from the sea, the season’s very last cherries and fish cooked fresh off the boat.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: Gorgeous Byron Bay with its stunning beaches and laidback lifestyle creates a perfect backdrop for Paul’s feast of the senses; the aroma of freshly ground coffee, beautiful clusters of Italian purple garlic and the delicate blueberry.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: North Queensland is a grower's paradise and Paul’s ready to enjoy the amazing array of fresh fruits, vegetables, seafood and meats on offer including juicy pineapples, a spot of tea and finally, some serious crocodile business.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: In this modern day Garden of Eden, that is Launceston and Northern Tasmania, Paul discovers the Valley of the Senses, is in sweet-tooth heaven on a raspberry farm and enjoys a spot of local fishing.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: Victoria's Bellarine Peninsula is filled with historic fishing towns, Paul’s in search of local mussels which are also used to create a unique beer plus sashimi that doesn’t come any fresher.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: Paul leads a gourmet tour of discovery in one of the world’s iconic cities, Sydney. With its lively fresh produce markets and colourful food stores, Paul’s preparing the ultimate al-fresco menu.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: Paul’s takes a taste adventure through the Gold Coast’s Hinterland where he meets a red hot tamale, learns the perfect way to enjoy excess fruit and discovers a true passion for pasta.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: Paul tours the Yarra Valley, fast becoming known for its free range food and incredible local produce. With plenty of lovely local cheese and wine to savour plus a local farmer’s market for inspiration, it’s foodie heaven.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: With the surf and sun as a backdrop, Paul’s going “bananas” in pursuit of fabulous food on Queensland’s Sunshine Coast. Known for its organic produce, there’s a stunning array of local fresh ingredients on offer.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: Paul visits the home of Australia’s high country cattlemen and The Man From Snowy River, seeking out free-range chickens, hand-picked olives, apples and hazelnuts plus some of the best beef around.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: Paul goes topless in the tropical paradise of Townsville to fish for barramundi and prawns, enjoy some uniquely flavoured ice-cream and find out why sugar means big business in these parts.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Noelle and Luke have been living in an apartment, but with three children it was time for a house with a backyard and …a dog to play in that backyard! Can Dr. Lisa Chimes find them the perfect dog?

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Single mum Jenny and her three kids live in a rented house with a big backyard and son Harrison wants a dog. The backyard is in need of repair and the family can’t decide on what sort of dog to get. Can they all agree on the one dog?

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Jo is a single mum with two little girls, she’d like a dog as part of their family. Jo loves running and would love a dog that can join her, but having two small girls a smaller dog might be better. Can Dr. Lisa find the right dog?

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Lisa and Stuart are hoping to find a playmate for their daughter, Roxy. Roxy has a list of things that she requires in her new ‘bestie’, but are they achievable? Dr. Lisa will search high and low to find Roxy her little friend.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: This family of four have four completely different ideas on what sort of dog they want. Dr. Lisa has her hands full! Can she find the dog for them?

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Dr. Lisa is given the job of finding a new family member for Cade & Matthew, still grieving the loss of their beautiful dog Callie. They want to find a new dog to join their family and help them heal the hurt.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Cheyne and Danielle live with a small menagerie, and want to add a dog to their blossoming family. With a sheep, and with four chickens running around in the backyard Dr. Lisa will need to keep her wits about her to find the right fit.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Career woman Kylie lives in an inner city apartment but wants some four legged company. Kylie has places to walk a new friend, but will Dr. Lisa give her the OK to have a dog in a small apartment? How do dogs cope in such an environment?

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Jess, has wanted a dog for as long as she can remember, but living with her parents and renting has thrown up several ‘road blocks’. Jess wants a dog that her mum will cope with, and that will get along with her other passion….her horses.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Julien & Nicolette have three daughters, and Keira, 4, has an irrational fear of dogs. Dr. Lisa advises that the best thing to do might be to get a dog. Will the cure work and what special issues do three young girls put in her way?

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: A big-hearted family needs Lisa's help to find them their first dog.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Bubbly single mum Edwina is looking for a dog to grow up with her two little girls, but she's torn when it comes to choosing between two adorable pooches.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim visits his mate Milton in the Northern Territory to help relocate a problem croc, then back home microchips baby wombats and koalas, weighs Betty the python and then heads into the bush to check on the health of some platypus.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim helps a friend move a 4-meter alligator from one pond to another, all in the name of love. He introduces us to one of his big passions, the Tasmanian Devil, and later, back at the park, extracts venom from snakes and spiders.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim takes a trip to Dreamworld to see the mighty power of the park’s tigers, attends an emergency call out for an injured bird of prey, and tells us about one of Australian wildlife’s biggest threats, the cane toad.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim and the team take their lives into their own hands entering the Alligator lagoon to retrieve eggs from some not so happy gator moms. Later he attends an emergency call-out to rescue a funnel web spider, and visits a bat rehab centre.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: A bully croc needs to be relocated in order to keep the peace. There’s the second installment of Tim’s quest to build a Tasmanian Devil insurance program at Devil Ark. And a rogue Death Adder is rescued from a bush garden.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: A visit to the Northern Territory and Tim is at a croc farm to see how problem wild crocs are dealt with. Back at the reptile park he introduces us to dingo pups Daisy and Dan before returning to Devil Ark to see how work is progressing.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim and longtime friend and fellow Reptile Park worker Obi put their lives on the line all in the name of love as they enter the cassowary enclosure. A call out to a local factory ends in another Peregrine Falcon rescue for Tim.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: In the NT Tim visits Kakadu and then a wildlife park dedicated to crocodiles. Back at the reptile park Cameron the cormorant’s life is on the line after swallowing discarded litter and Tim introduces an array of amphibians.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim ventures out for a bit of night hunting for crocs. At the park he discovers a Tiger Snake has added to the brood. A Galapagos Tortoise is put on the scales before rookie keeper Kyle is put through his paces with his first croc feed.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim revisits Devil Ark to see how the breeding program is coming along. Reptile Royalty settles in at the park in the form of Komodo Dragons Kracken and Daenerys and twins dedicated to nursing injured birds get a visit from Tim.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Fun and frolics as the reptile park's yellow footed wallaby clan is caught and tagged. Tim explores the Tasmanian coast and Southern Ocean to see birdlife, dolphins and seals

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: A koala escapes from his enclosure to go on the hunt for love. A king cobra has an issue with its eye that needs dealing with and Tim tours Tasmania's Serengeti and encounters kangaroos, wombats, echidna and some rare feathered friends.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: In the very first Just Go episode Rhys uncovers some hidden gems in the Victorian town of Bendigo. Lee learns the secret behind some delicious but healthy food, and Geoff Cox visits tropical Port Douglas.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: On Queensland’s famous Gold Coast Lee explores iconic attractions and dines at a very entertaining restaurant. Rhys tries out a fun, unusual way to get fit in Melbourne, while Geoff Cox takes Lee to see Australia’s magnificent red centre.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: Lee and Rhys explore Victoria’s Bellarine Peninsula. Lee finds foodie heaven on the delicious Taste Trail, while Rhys jumps aboard the Blues Train in historic Queenscliff. Geoff Cox discovers a capital way to see the sights in Canberra.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: Rhys tours the world-class wine country of the Yarra Valley in style. Lee taste tests a breakfast with a twist and experiences the tantalizing delights of African cuisine. Geoff Cox explores Sydney.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: Lee visit the New South Wales north coast and gets up close to majestic wildlife in Byron Bay, then heads south to Melbourne for a foodie fix that takes her back to her Chinese roots. Rhys and Geoff Cox head to Albury on the Murray River.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: Lee explores the Mornington Peninsula, a destination that offers plenty to see and do, then cooks up a storm Vietnamese style and shares some of her favourite recipes. Rhys and Geoff Cox discover the beautiful New South Wales south coast.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: Rhys explores the Victorian coastal town of Inverloch, finding some high-octane fun. Lee discovers a hidden gem amongst Melbourne’s skyline, while Geoff Cox experiences the beautiful Tasmanian wilderness near Strahan.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: Lee explores the other side to Queensland’s Gold Coast – its stunning hinterland and learns some tricks to cooking delicious cuisine from the USA. Rhys and Coxy take it up a notch in Yarrawonga, on the Victorian and New South Wales border.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: Rhys shares the secrets of Phillip Island - his hometown on Victoria’s rugged coastline. Lee travels to Alice Springs on the hunt for bush tucker, and Coxy enjoys the Queensland sunshine and plenty of activities in tropical Mackay.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: In this China special, Rhys soars above the clouds on his way up one of China’s most spectacular mountains, Geoff Cox takes in the sights in Tianjin, and Rhys visits Fenghuang, a picturesque city that hasn’t changed in three hundred years.

programme.title: Tattoo Tales
programme.desc: Step inside a busy Bondi tattoo studio where tourists, backpackers and local hipsters flock to get inked. A brother and sister remember Mum and a Russian burlesque dancer shocks the staff.

programme.title: Tattoo Tales
programme.desc: Grand Final day in Bondi sees Brit boys mixing it up with quirky tatts and belly bling, a young Mother’s first time braving the needle and a visit from the studios eldest client – an 83 year old grandmother.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In an emotion charged episode, Chris is on a desperate rescue mission to save the life of a frail 3 day old orphan foal. Brulee has lost his mum, and won't survive unless Chris can find him a surrogate. But it's no guarantee a mare will accept the little foal.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris meets a labradoodle with a chronic sneezing problem. 2 year old Lulu suffers massive sneezing fits up to 4 times a day, and her devoted owner Kim is desperate for help. Chris fears Lulu may have a tumour.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has been invited to Abu Dhabi after a special invitation to visit an extraordinary veterinary hospital. The hospital is for sick and injured falcons, and they are treated like royalty. Chris has to preform delicate surgery on a falcon wing.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A tiny kitten has been found abandoned in a cardboard box, and Chris is shocked at the extent of her injuries. She desperately needs surgery to try to repair her shattered leg. Then it's a heartwarming search to find her a new home.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: The finale to Chris's trip is an unforgettable encounter with some of China's precious Giant Pandas. Chris is granted the rare privilege of hand feeding some youngsters. He's then allowed into the most sacred area of all - the panda kindergarten to meet the adorable babies.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is confronted with an unusual patient, an albino echidna. But there's a question mark over whether the extremely rare echidna is a male or a female. It will have to be anaesthetised so Chris can investigate.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Tiny Amari has been born with a badly twisted back leg. At just 3 days old she's one of the youngest kittens Chris has ever seen at the clinic. The brave little battler needs a series of splints to try to save her leg, and give her a second chance.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has travelled to the Cook Island to help out at a busy vet clinic in the capital Rarotonga. His first patient is Princess, a hit run victim. Chris quickly finds out just how tough it is looking after the local pets, with only basic facilities and limited supplies.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is spending 2 weeks volunteering at the busy Esther Honey vet clinic in the Cook Islands. This week his first patient is a much loved cat called Small One, which has part of its nose missing. Chris is immediately concerned that Small One may have a skin cancer.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris makes a special trip to Karara in Queensland to see Stubby, a tiny 3-week-old piglet, born with only one trotter. Stubby is struggling to get around. If the brave little battler is to survive, Chris needs to work out a way for her to walk normally.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris travels to Edgars Mission on the outskirts of Melbourne, where he is faced with a very woolly fugitive. Ben Hall is a sheep that was rescued after 5 years on the run, and Chris is shocked at the condition of his heavy coat. The thick, matted wool could be hiding all sorts of health problems.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is visiting remote Christmas Island where he has to help a seabird named Bill that is unable to fly. Bill is a rare Abbott’s Booby, and she's missing critical flight feathers. Chris needs to treat Bill's deformed wing, before starting rehabilitation with the young rescue bird.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: FREMANTLE The major port of Australia’s remote west coast, Fremantle began life as a place of punishment. But the ethnically diverse port city has since been the sight of some of Australia’s greatest triumphs… and disappointments.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: MELBOURNE The real story of Melbourne isn’t found in the grand tree-lined boulevards or boomtown architecture. It’s hidden down the lanes and alleyways.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: HOBART You need only scratch the surface to find evidence of Hobart’s convict past – but dig a little deeper and even more fascinating history is revealed.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: WOOLLOOMOOLOO From the Razor gangs of the 1930s to the Heritage Battles of the 1960s, Woolloomooloo has seen it all.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: BENDIGO Bendigo was one of the biggest gold finds in history. it’s literally built on rivers of gold. Her grand hotels and theatres have played host to international celebrities… and some shady characters too.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: NEWCASTLE Like it's English namesake, Australia’s Newcastle also has a reputation for toughness and heavy toil, but it’s also a town with a unique identity, a rich maritime history and more than its share of eccentric characters.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: CARLTON Well known as the headquarters for generations of crime bosses, Carlton was also the epicentre to a creative outpouring in the 1960s and 70s that lead to the emergence of a uniquely Australian film and theatre culture.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: BRISBANE In 1941 sleepy tropical Brisbane found itself the nerve centre for the Pacific War effort. The former convict colony found itself changing quickly, yet politically Queensland is the most conservative state in Australia.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: ST KILDA Once a seaside retreat for 19 Century yuppies, later a suburb defined by the heroin addicts who flocked there, St Kilda has endured a constant cycle of boom and bust – Today it is again one of Melbourne’s most desired addresses.

programme.title: You Cant Win Em All
programme.desc: As the Ottoman Empire collapses throughout Turkey in 1922, a number of adventurers from all over the world sign on to protect the locals from thieves and marauders--for a hefty price. Two such mercenaries are Adam and Josh, who are hired by provincial Turkish governor Osman. Adam and Josh are expected to protect their boss' gold shipment, and to provide safe conduct for Osman Bey's three daughters. Along the way, our 'heroes' decide to forget their mission and abscond with the gold, but their plans are foiled by their own inherent ineptitude--and by the bothersome interference of duplicitous Colonel Elci.

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programme.desc: A tech inventor Sandra Hutchins from Silicon Valley disappears aboard a chartered ship out at sea. This leaves many, including other passengers and the authorities, wondering what happened to her and if her invention had anything to do with her disappearance.

programme.title: Beyond Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: Examining real cases and critical events where truth, consequence, and human decisions collide.

programme.title: InJustice
programme.desc: A child serial killer terrorizes the city of Saskatoon; a high school student is tortured to death over the course of a weekend by a gang. The killer, a man who was pronounced clinically dead in an ambulance and later revived, embarked on a string of serial murders six months later.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: After bubbly Beth marries her college sweetheart, Mike, newlywed bliss takes a turn when Beth finds blood in their home Â- and Mike's gone. Seeking answers, police wade through a twisting tale of underworld ties, secret lives and sexual seduction.

programme.title: Kids In Prison
programme.desc: We look inside the intake process inside a juvenile detention center in northwest Indiana. Scenes include police arriving at the center with teens in handcuffs, and two of the teens—brothers—going through the intake process. Intake includes two intake probation officers conducting interviews with the boys before they are escorted back to the cell units, showered in, and put into a cell. The episode features a 2023 update at the end of the video on the boys and where they are today.

programme.title: Kids In Prison
programme.desc: We meet teenager Stedman as he served time in the segregation unit in a juvenile prison for attacking another teen inside the prison. Stedman talked to us from the segregation unit's outdoor "rec cage, " a razor wire area where teens in Seg get to spend 1 hour a day. The rest of the time they are locked in their cells 23 hours a day, 7 days a week. We also meet a correctional officers as they take a camera crew on a tour of the prison's Segregation unit, describe how kids land there, and discuss the prison's security measures during daily life on the unit. A 2023 update on Stedman is included at the end of the episode.

programme.title: Air France Flight 8969: The Gign That Destroyed Algerian Insurgents
programme.desc: Experience the terrifying ordeal of Flight 8969, a routine journey from Algeria to Paris turned into a nightmare. As passengers settle in for the flight, they are suddenly plunged into chaos as a group known as the GIA hijacks the plane. Witness the harrowing moments as the French GIGN races against time to rescue the hostages and thwart the terrorists' plans. Join us as we unravel the gripping tale of courage and survival in the face of unimaginable terror aboard Flight 8969.

programme.title: Obi Wan Nairobi: The Sas Operator That Annihilated Nairobi Insurgents
programme.desc: SAS operator Christian Craighead takes center stage as we unravel the tragic events of the Nairobi hotel siege. Join us to witness Christian's heroic efforts in eliminating terrorists and hear the firsthand account of the intense moments from the initial siege to the valiant actions of first responders. Our coverage goes beyond the surface, providing a detailed and comprehensive overview of the harrowing attack. Gain unique insights into the bravery displayed by Christian Craighead and others, shedding light on the impact of this shocking event and its implications for security and counterterrorism measures.

programme.title: Pusherman: Frank Lucas & The True Story Of American Gangster
programme.desc: Pusherman is the real-life story of Frank Lucas, the Harlem dope-dealer who smuggled pure heroin from Southeast Asia's "Golden Triangle" into the U.S. inside the coffins of dead GI's flown back from Vietnam. Narrated by Mark Jacobson, who wrote the original story for New York magazine, that the hit movie, "American Gangster," was based on, and produced by Legs McNeil, award-winning best-selling author and film documentarian, with extra commentary by Daily News and New York Magazine crime writer, Michael Daly. Pusherman will reveal the spectacular story of heroin and Vietnam and the cultural phenomena known as Blaxploitation films in the 1970's. The ending reveals the epidemic of police corruption in New York City during the 1970's-- all the subjects and stories the $255 million grossing film, "American Gangster" left out.

programme.title: Crime Stories
programme.desc: Firsthand accounts, dramatic re-enactments and archival news footage are used to paint comprehensive pictures of the high-profile cases and the law enforcement agents who investigated them.

programme.title: Dark Waters of Crime
programme.desc: Water is at the centre of the human experience. The source of life on earth, it is also a place of mystery and danger. For criminals, water is the perfect accomplice for the perfect crime: it erases, absorbs, and carries the bodies, conceals weapons and washes away evidence. For detectives, water is a crafty adversary. It never confesses, forcing the investigators to employ extraordinary measures to discover the truth. Dark Waters of Crime does not simply oppose the criminals and the investigators. It brings into play a third party, powerful, mysterious, and tenacious.

programme.title: Life with Murder
programme.desc: When their son is accused of murdering his sister, a mother and father face perhaps the most awful decision any parent could have to make: whether to break with their son or accept him back into the family. With astonishing footage shot over a ten-year period, from minutes after the crime was committed to the present, the film follows the family's evolving relationships.

programme.title: North Korea: Life Inside the Secret State
programme.desc: North Koreans are breaking down the barriers of the gulag state. Following covert filmmakers, this doc shows real life under the new leader Kim Jong Un, highlighting the contrasting ox-drawn farms to the glittering life of the elite in Pyongyang. The starving children on the streets are of artificial food shortages engendered by corruption. See how USBs, cell phones and DVDs from the South are transforming North Koreans' views of their world.

programme.title: Murder Remembered - Norfolk County 1950
programme.desc: This feature-length docu-drama brings us back to 1950 in a smalltown Ontario bank, the scene of an armed hold-up by Herbert McAuliffe. By nightfall, two men are dead. The robber flees, and for three days the community of Norfolk County lives in fear. Gritty re-enactments and first-hand accounts show the manhunt and eventual trial, shedding new light on McAuliffe's personality--his tragic childhood and respected WWII record. The result is a thought-provoking contribution to the debate on capital punishment.

programme.title: British Gangsters: Faces Of The Underworld
programme.desc: Everyone has the right to tell their story… The powerful and thought-provoking documentary series returns with eight more fascinating episodes. Bernard O’Mahoney takes the helm once again as he interviews some of the most notorious ‘faces’ in recent history, taking the viewer on a brand new journey that brings the story of crime up-to-date. The best-selling true-crime author and former Essex Boys gang member travels to Liverpool, Birmingham, Belfast, Dublin and Essex and guides us through tales of drugs, gangs, political terrorism and ultimately, consequences.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: A family man is found shot to death and dumped in a rural orchard; it looks like a carjacking. Police meticulously piece together surveillance video that seems to show a mystery woman park his car and walk away.

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programme.desc: A tech inventor Sandra Hutchins from Silicon Valley disappears aboard a chartered ship out at sea. This leaves many, including other passengers and the authorities, wondering what happened to her and if her invention had anything to do with her disappearance.

programme.title: Beyond Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: Examining real cases and critical events where truth, consequence, and human decisions collide.

programme.title: InJustice
programme.desc: A child serial killer terrorizes the city of Saskatoon; a high school student is tortured to death over the course of a weekend by a gang. The killer, a man who was pronounced clinically dead in an ambulance and later revived, embarked on a string of serial murders six months later.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: After bubbly Beth marries her college sweetheart, Mike, newlywed bliss takes a turn when Beth finds blood in their home Â- and Mike's gone. Seeking answers, police wade through a twisting tale of underworld ties, secret lives and sexual seduction.

programme.title: Kids In Prison
programme.desc: We meet teenager Stedman as he served time in the segregation unit in a juvenile prison for attacking another teen inside the prison. Stedman talked to us from the segregation unit's outdoor "rec cage, " a razor wire area where teens in Seg get to spend 1 hour a day. The rest of the time they are locked in their cells 23 hours a day, 7 days a week. We also meet a correctional officers as they take a camera crew on a tour of the prison's Segregation unit, describe how kids land there, and discuss the prison's security measures during daily life on the unit. A 2023 update on Stedman is included at the end of the episode.

programme.title: Kids In Prison
programme.desc: We look inside the intake process inside a juvenile detention center in northwest Indiana. Scenes include police arriving at the center with teens in handcuffs, and two of the teens—brothers—going through the intake process. programme.title: Kids In Prison Then & Now
programme.desc: 18-year old Akheem prepares for his release hearing in front of a juvenile prison "parole board," and talks to our cameras about his hopes and dreams in the final days of life behind bars. 14-year old Paul awaits word on the appeal of his 25 year prison sentence while inside a maximum-security juvenile prison. A 2023 update is provided at the end of the episode.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Millions were inspired by the first “Role of the Man” show. Now, Dr. Phil is making it an ongoing series and checking in with past guests. Remember the husband who provided everything for his wife…except intimacy? He’s back! Are they now sleeping in the same bed? Then, you’ll hear from the man who wanted his wife to have sex with him on demand. Did he change his selfish ways or is he still in the doghouse? Plus, what’s a mama’s boy to do when his wife insists he cut the umbilical cord once and for all?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Baronica and Nathan say that on July 10, 2021, their then 9-year-old son shot his 8-year-old brother in the chest with one of six unsecured guns in their home. The parents bravely come forward to tell their story in hopes that other parents will learn from their mistakes. Then, Kristin says the last time she saw her 15-year-old son, Ethan, he was heading to his best friend’s house. Within hours, she was informed Ethan had been killed by an unsecured gun in his best friend’s house. Kristin has fought to have Ethan’s Law enacted in CT, which ensures that parents are held accountable for the safe storage of their weapons. And, hear from Susan, whose daughter Amanda was sitting on a park bench when she was shot by a group of young people, leaving her paralyzed. Plus, Ryan Busse, a former gun industry executive who says he left the industry after seeing how fear tactics were being used to sell guns, joins the conversation. This is a show every parent needs to watch -- whether you own a firearm or not.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation continues with a woman who says her sister lied about health diagnoses for attention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pamela says in just nine days, she is likely going to jail for not complying with court orders because she refuses to allow her ex, Justin, his court-ordered visitations with their children. Pamela says she believes Justin is a dangerous narcissist who she claims has locked the kids out of the house and attempted to drown their oldest daughter in the pool. Pamela says she will do whatever it takes to protect her kids from Justin, even if that means going to jail. Justin claims Pamela is a hateful, controlling, bitter ex, who has brainwashed their children into making up stories, and says Pamela’s claims of abuse are lies! These parents have been back and forth to court and claim nothing has been resolved. So, who is telling the truth? Is Justin an abusive father, or is Pamela a jealous ex making up stories for revenge? Can Dr. Phil get these parents on the same page for the sake of their children? Find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In the last 10 years, the number of women arrested for driving drunk has risen by 30 percent, and police report that more and more young children are sitting in the back seat when these moms are pulled over.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. Dr. Phil sits down with Corey and Kim, a troubled young couple, to see if their relationship can be saved.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part two, the estranged husband of missing mom, Julie Ann Gonzalez, takes a polygraph test.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Did a woman accused of fake pregnancies really lie?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: For many girls, a fairytale wedding day is a sweet fantasy -- but getting the proposal can be a real nightmare! Amber and Rich are struggling through commitment issues. They live, work and have children together, and say they're happy but can't seem to take the next step. Rich sold Amber on his plan to marry her after five years, so why hasn't he proposed after nearly seven? Does he have valid reasons for resisting marriage? After Dr. Phil challenges him, will Rich decide to walk down the aisle ... on Dr. Phil's stage? Next, Jill has taken the leap and been divorced seven times. Why does she pick the wrong men, and what can she do to make her next union last? Then, Candy describes her first marriage as lasting 18 miserable years, and she regrets how she poisoned her daughters against men during that time. What will it take to change her daughter, who calls herself the Runaway Bride? Plus, a don't-miss moment happens in Dr. Phil's audience!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents, listen up! Did you know that 94 percent of American kids ages 12 to 17 use the Internet, and 58 percent of them have an online profile? We're living in a digital world, where photos and other content can be published online for the world to see in an instant. You may not know it, but your child may be one click away from disaster.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How has the role of the man evolved in the modern family? One woman claims her husband provides her with everything—except love and affection. He says he only knows how to provide financially. Can Dr. Phil help them find a balance and save their marriage of 17 years? Then, one guest entered into a new relationship after leaving his wife and kids. Now, his guilt is causing him to lie, manipulate and become physically abusive. Find out what Dr. Phil has to say to these men about the true measure of a man’s success in a relationship!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Millions were inspired by the first “Role of the Man” show. Now, Dr. Phil is making it an ongoing series and checking in with past guests. Remember the husband who provided everything for his wife…except intimacy? He’s back! Are they now sleeping in the same bed? Then, you’ll hear from the man who wanted his wife to have sex with him on demand. Did he change his selfish ways or is he still in the doghouse? Plus, what’s a mama’s boy to do when his wife insists he cut the umbilical cord once and for all?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christina, 21, and her younger sister, Carlie, 13, say they had a close relationship with their father, Michael, until two years ago when he decided to transition to a female. Michael was a police officer, soldier and loving parent who lived his life as a male for 40 years. Now, he wants his daughters to call him Mom, because he says Dad is gone, but they refuse. Michael, who prefers to be called Kayla, says she wants to explain to her daughters why she's living as a woman, but they've never given her the chance. The last time Christina saw her father was two years ago when he showed up at her work in lace and blue jeans to break the news that he's transgendered. When she sees Kayla onstage, does she greet her with open arms? Next, Carlie joins her sister and father. She says she wants her old dad back, but will she feel the same after seeing Kayla? Can the father-daughter bond be turned into a mother-daughter one? Be prepared for an emotional journey as two daughters struggle to understand how someone they loved so much could hurt them so badly.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Attention men: If you have a child on the way, or dream of being a father some day, you don’t want to miss this show! A little-known law could keep you from having any rights to your child. Bryce and Esther dated for one month before Esther became pregnant. Bryce says he wanted to marry Esther and raise their child together, but Esther says she wasn’t ready to be a mother. When they broke up, Esther decided to place the baby for adoption without informing Bryce. When Bryce finally learned his daughter was born, she was already seven days old and placed with another family. Then, Dawn worked hard to shed 150 pounds, and when the new svelte Dawn met Paul, sparks flew! He thought she was hot -- until she undressed. What is she hiding? Plus, discover why Dr. Phil wrestles with his decision to help Dawn and Paul. And, Cynthia says she’s embarrassed by her boyfriend’s outdated wardrobe, and refuses to be seen with him in public! Can a professional makeover change her opinion?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From accusations of cheating to criticizing their clothing and secret DNA tests -- these wives say their husbands could be the worst in America! Brian and Nicole recently celebrated their first wedding anniversary, but the newlyweds say there is already trouble in paradise. Nicole says that Brian is so controlling, that he must know her whereabouts at all times and will call her up to 25 times in a row to make sure she’s not cheating. Brian admits he doesn’t trust Nicole, and simply wants her to respect him. Growing frustrated, the couple says unless they come to a compromise, they are prepared to part ways. What does Dr. Phil say they must do to get their marriage back on track? Then, Shaunna says she feels like a prisoner in her own home. She says her husband terrifies her and controls every aspect of her life, from how she dresses and styles her hair, to when she can leave the house and whom and what she can look at in public. Aaron says he's just trying to help his wife, but then why is he a no-show on Dr. Phil's stage? Can Dr. Phil help Shaunna find her way out? Plus, learn the steps you must take to ensure a safe exit from an abuser’s tight grip.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sue says her husband of 12 years, Andy, is verbally abusive and that she’s so scared of him, she remains submissive -- including getting drunk and having sex with him -- to keep the peace. She says, “If he’s going to kill me, he’s going to kill me. I feel like I’m already dead.” So, why is she worried that Andy will leave her? Andy admits that he can be a bully, loses his temper and calls Sue vile names, but he says the duties of a wife are to have sex, cook and clean -- and Sue doesn't carry her weight around the house. After breaking up numerous times, why do they keep reuniting? And, hear from Sue’s two adult children. What do they say contributes to the chaos in their mom and Andy’s relationship? Is there hope for this couple’s marriage, or should they cut ties?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shara claims that her newlywed husband, Luke, is a “mean, insecure know-it-all” who won’t let her own a cell phone, hold a job or leave the house alone -- and also dictates how she should dress and wear her makeup. Luke denies all of Shara’s allegations and claims that she is “no angel” and has a vicious temper. Can this marriage be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Natalie says her husband, Brian, was in a tragic work accident in 2015 when he fell from a 68-foot crane. She says he was paralyzed from the knees down and claims he has stopped trying to live life. Natalie claims that since the accident, Brian has treated her and their 13-year old son, Jacob, like his slaves instead of his family. Natalie says her marriage with Brian has changed, and they don’t know how to communicate with one another. Brian says his family doesn’t understand what he is going through and that he is in too much pain to move. Brian also says Natalie’s parents, Sharyn and Dave, are too involved in his family’s lives, which is causing tension. Sharyn and Dave say they were trying to help their daughter since Natalie took on all of the responsibilities in her household.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks to controlling guests and the loved ones who feel trapped by them. Jeffrey hates that his wife of seven months, Mindy, goes out clubbing with her younger friends, who he says are a bad influence on her. Mindy leaves the kids with Jeffrey's 16-year-old daughter and parties until 6:00 a.m., while he works the night shift. Mindy calls Jeffrey “a warden,” and says if he had his way, she’d never leave the house. Then, Jason claims his wife, Terrie, is lazy. He says he has to clean the house, do chores, take care of the kids and balance two checkbooks! Terrie says her large chest and arthritis prevent her from doing household tasks. Can Jason get his wife to clean up her act?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How has the role of the man evolved in the modern family? One woman claims her husband provides her with everything—except love and affection. He says he only knows how to provide financially. Can Dr. Phil help them find a balance and save their marriage of 17 years? Then, one guest entered into a new relationship after leaving his wife and kids. Now, his guilt is causing him to lie, manipulate and become physically abusive. Find out what Dr. Phil has to say to these men about the true measure of a man’s success in a relationship!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Millions were inspired by the first “Role of the Man” show. Now, Dr. Phil is making it an ongoing series and checking in with past guests. Remember the husband who provided everything for his wife…except intimacy? He’s back! Are they now sleeping in the same bed? Then, you’ll hear from the man who wanted his wife to have sex with him on demand. Did he change his selfish ways or is he still in the doghouse? Plus, what’s a mama’s boy to do when his wife insists he cut the umbilical cord once and for all?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Attention men: If you have a child on the way, or dream of being a father some day, you don’t want to miss this show! A little-known law could keep you from having any rights to your child. Bryce and Esther dated for one month before Esther became pregnant. Bryce says he wanted to marry Esther and raise their child together, but Esther says she wasn’t ready to be a mother. When they broke up, Esther decided to place the baby for adoption without informing Bryce. When Bryce finally learned his daughter was born, she was already seven days old and placed with another family. Now Bryce is fighting to get his child back, but because of an obscure law in some states, he has lost his rights as a father. What law did Bryce fail to comply with that even the lawyers in this case weren’t previously aware of? Is he unfit as a father, or is this law unconstitutional? Bryce and Esther’s lawyers give their opinion. Plus, the grandparents at odds over Esther’s decision face off. Don’t miss this heated discussion and learn more about the Putative Fathers Registry!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christina, 21, and her younger sister, Carlie, 13, say they had a close relationship with their father, Michael, until two years ago when he decided to transition to a female. Michael was a police officer, soldier and loving parent who lived his life as a male for 40 years. Now, he wants his daughters to call him Mom, because he says Dad is gone, but they refuse. Michael, who prefers to be called Kayla, says she wants to explain to her daughters why she's living as a woman, but they've never given her the chance. The last time Christina saw her father was two years ago when he showed up at her work in lace and blue jeans to break the news that he's transgendered. When she sees Kayla onstage, does she greet her with open arms? Next, Carlie joins her sister and father. She says she wants her old dad back, but will she feel the same after seeing Kayla? Can the father-daughter bond be turned into a mother-daughter one? Be prepared for an emotional journey as two daughters struggle to understand how someone they loved so much could hurt them so badly.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A 13-year-old's powerful and disturbing diary entries have Dr. Phil very concerned. Trisha says her daughter's pain stems from her father's discipline. How do you know if your discipline crosses the line into abuse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into a tragic story that spanned several decades, shattered lives and left one person behind bars. Fourteen children were held captive by a man who called himself The Messiah … a man who was also their father. Jeanne says she was raised in this environment, which the authorities called cult-like, and that she and her siblings were starved, beaten and had no schooling. In a tear-jerking revelation, Jeanne tells Dr. Phil that she was forced to perform unthinkable sexual acts with her own father, beginning when she was just 5 years old and ending when she was 27. Jeanne may be a victim of horrible cruelty, but her sisters, Miriam and Sarah, say they can’t forgive her for the pain she caused them. Find out why these siblings are estranged, and why Sarah says she’s nervous just sitting next to Jeanne on Dr. Phil’s stage. It’s been 20 years since Jeanne’s father was arrested, but she and her family say the effects of abuse still linger. Can these siblings ever get closure on their horrific past?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil tackles two news stories that have captivated millions. First up, is it ever appropriate to confront your child’s bullies? That’s what James Jones says he did when he boarded his 12-year-old daughter, Chatari’s, school bus, and the video of his tirade went viral! James says some of the students terrorized his child, who suffers from cerebral palsy, and his actions resulted in two second-degree misdemeanor charges against him. CNN contributor Roland Martin joins the show, and he says James should be named Father of the Year for protecting Chatari, who was reportedly hit, called names and had condoms thrown at her. Roland goes head-to-head with attorney Areva Martin, who says James’s behavior was unwarranted. Did this dad cross the line? What does Dr. Phil think? Plus, the disappearance of David Hartley reads like a murder mystery. His wife, Tiffany, says they were on vacation when David was shot in the head by Mexican pirates while jet skiing. His body was never recovered, and Mexican authorities question if the event really occurred. Some people wonder if Tiffany was involved, but she maintains her innocence. Find out why she declined a lie detector test, and hear Dr. Phil’s strong message for her.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From spending $600,000 on 3-year-old beauty queens, to pushy stage sisters and an ambitious boxing coach — today's guests say they go to the extremes to help the youngest members of their family excel. Meet two fathers, one whose full-time job is managing his tiny stars' careers, and the other who hand makes each and every one of his 4-year-old daughter's costumes. Are these dads bonding with their daughters or simply pushing too hard? Plus, meet several women who defiantly criticize child beauty pageants. And, hear from one overzealous sister and the father of a boxing champion once ranked first in the world. Can Dr. Phil convince these guests to step aside and strive for balance in their children's lives?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sisters Rylie, 23, and Lenae, 26, claim their father, Leonard, was extremely physically and verbally abusive during their childhood and that they lived in constant fear of him — allegations he absolutely denies. They also claim their mother, Susan, did not protect them from him. Rylie claims the alleged abuse was so damaging that she believes it’s the cause of her diagnosis of Borderline Personality Disorder. Lenae says the many years of alleged verbal abuse have led to self-loathing and even an eating disorder. Leonard admits to having a tough disciplinary style, but refutes his daughters accusations — even saying they’ve blown everything out of proportion.

Cherylyn says she maxed out her 19 credit cards on designer shoes, handbags, purses, clothes, makeup and pampering! And, Cherylyn says she insists on fine dining, fast cars and her boyfriend, Tyler, footing the bill. However, Tyler says he has nothing more to give Cherylyn except an ultimatum, which he delivers when he comes face-to-face with her onstage. Cherylyn's mom, Joey, says that her selfish and manipulative daughter has blown over $130,000 in less than a year and her spending has left a trail of devastation which includes pawning over $7,000 worth of family heirlooms and stealing her identity. Matt says he and three friends were drinking at a party nearly nine months ago when the four boys had sex with a 16-year-old classmate. He claims she initiated the encounter and that the sex was consensual. Matt and the three boys are charged with second-degree rape, and Matt says his dreams of getting a college scholarship have been put on hold. How does he describe the events of that night? And, what, if anything, does he say he’d do differently? Then, hear from the alleged victim, who is speaking out for the first time. What does she recall happening that night? And, how has the ordeal impacted her life? Plus, Matt’s parents, Dianne and Mark, insist their son is innocent and say they believe the alleged victim is out for attention. Dr. Phil has a powerful message for the couple.

Why does she say her peers care more about the accused football players than they do her? Don’t miss Matt and his parents’ reactions to what she has to say. Then, Leah alleges that in 2011, her 15-year-old daughter, Rehtaeh, was raped by four classmates at a party, and that after nearly a year-and-a-half of relentless bullying, the teen took her own life. How could this have been prevented? And what message does Leah have for others in similar situations? Plus, hear from Alexis, who says she too was raped at 15 and “could’ve been Rehtaeh.” What does she say got her through her darkest moments? Don’t miss this powerful cautionary tale for every teen and parent! This program contains strong sexual content.

programme.desc: Claude Konrad loves his town of Bienne and has decided to revive its industrial past. Because Bienne, a watchmaking and factory town, was full of companies, including the American General Motors. But Bienne is also home to factories of radiophonic machines, bicycles and pianos.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: Worthy heir to the Nabi movement, the painter Nathanaëlle Herbelin opens the doors to his studio. Nature's organic forms are omnipresent in the works created by cabinet-maker Maxime Goléo.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: Antoine introduces AndrŽane Lanthier-Nadeau to Alexis, who he met on the competition circuit. The threesome head off in search of the steepest trails on the Sea to Sky Highway in Pemberton.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: To Meudon and a private tour of Rodin's studio. Virginie Friedmann and Delphine Versace: a love story filled with sublime materials and unexpected surprises. Gucci's fashion garden brings bucolic effervescence and a touch of vintage to the 2025 cruise collection. Making the "chistera", exceptional know-how in the Basque country.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Welcome to the kingdom of creativity: the visionary refurbishment of L'Oréal's historic headquarters! All about the history of Adidas and Pumas' trainers: an internecine war. When ties and feathers are upcycled into clothing: encounter with Marion Oliver-Williamson, founder of MOW. Dare to be bold: wearing capri pants.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.desc: He is a legend of French television, an iconic presenter, director and man of culture. Antoine de Caunes has influenced generations with his unique sense of irreverence. He comes to tell us about his relationship with art and to talk about "Antoine de Caunes, la vie rêvée d'un enfant du rock", the Canal+ documentary series. Also with us is Marguerite Li-Garrigue, one of the most promising artists on the contemporary scene: a unique universe, a rare intensity and a passion for insects, at the heart of delicate and powerful works. Canadian painter Kent Monkman as seen by Alex Vizorek, in the Vizorek'xpert column.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: Pastry chef and baker, for Benoît Castel sharing his culinary philosophy is a delicious pleasure. The craftsman Pascal Le Bonhomme recounts his enthusiasm for globes.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: The Cluny Museum recounts mediaeval art. Gastronomy on a plate with chef Victor Mercier: you don't need to travel far to discover new horizons! Bold, powerful and always sublime, Saint Laurent artistic director Anthony Vaccarello transforms women. Creations by ceramist Charlotte Castro.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: An encounter with an artist known for turning paper flowers into poetry, Marianne Guély: the designer steps into the scented world of perfumer Symrise. All about boned corsets. A visit to Mirecourt, in the Vosges, French capital of violin and bow-making. How to wear the colour orange.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: David Foutimasseur loves tinkering with whatever comes to hand, as long as there is a bicycle part, movement, and that it makes him laugh. This inveterate inventor is full of ideas to transform things into sculptures and he also builds the inventions of Gaston Lagaffe.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: In Boulogne-Billancourt, the Paul Belmondo Museum is dedicated to the sculptor's work. Interior designer Anne-Sophie Pailleret puts all her talent into each detail.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: The adventure continues in Whistler. Alexis and Antoine have two goals: riding in the famous park and meeting Yoann Barelli, a true pro with thousands of followers on social media.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: The Villèle Museum covers the history of Reunion Island and of slavery in the 18th century. From minuscule to immense, Grégoire Scalabre sculpts and assembles, plunging us into a different dimension. Marine Serre: the 2025 spring-summer collection, veritable message of love. Séverine and Christophe, manufacturing Basque knives.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: The book "Indémodables", by Hayley Edwards Dujardin, takes us on an enlightening journey to discover the how and why of the clothes we choose. All about exhibition inaugurations. Teintures de France: innovative techniques for the fashion industry. How to wear the tennis look.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: The Theatre of the Montreurs d'images is celebrating its 40th anniversary. For the occasion, the couple of committed artists, Monique Décosterd and Marco Jaccoud, are united by a project linked to the primary forest.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: From the 17th century to the modern-day, the Préfecture de Police Museum recounts the history of the institution. Two Michelin-starred chef Nicolas Beaumann shines at Maison Rostang.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: Direction Saint-Ferreol-les-Neiges near Mont-Sainte-Anne. This is where Patrice Drouin lives, a leading forerunner in mountain biking and international event creator.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: Pau, today home to a museum dedicated to Henri IV. Designer and interior designer, Chloé Nègre creates colourful spaces bringing the beauty of handiwork and craftsmanship to life. Celebrating his brand's 10th anniversary, Charles Jeffrey presents a runway show centred on utility. Denis Tomasina restores old clocks.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Protecting the past and preparing the future, antiques dealers have their own fair: welcome to FAB Paris! The story of Cartier's Tank watches. A magical visit to a showcase for skill and craftsmanship: the Saint-Cyr workshops in the Community of the Seine-Eure Conurbation. How to wear a denim dress.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.desc: An exceptional guest in "La Grande Galerie Francophone", Ali Baddou and his columnists welcome Rachida Dati. The French Minister of Culture defends culture for all, accessible everywhere. She tells us how to make art an everyday experience and what it brings to her own life. There is also a meeting with the artist Bianca Bondi, who introduces us to her installations: a world apart where objects, plants and salt crystals are transformed into living landscapes. And Alex Vizorek tells us all about the Finnish artist Pekka Halonen, it's the Vizorek'xpert section.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: Sorting real from fake at the Museum of Counterfeiting. We join Marin Montagut, multi-talented designer and Paris-lover, on a poetic voyage.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: At the edge of the Fontainebleau Forest, we visit a museum dedicated to the Barbizon painters. Diane Benoit du Rey paints light on canvas and light fittings. Between textile craftwork, painting and sport, the brand 3. Paradis, cultural fusion. Decorative gilder, there's gold at the tip of Élisabeth Bonjean's paintbrush.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Expressing beauty and identity, African fashion is revealing itself and flourishing: a trend reshaping the fashion world. From yesterday to today, the history and precepts of French haute couture provide not just clothing but a touch of fantasy. Press relations and press days: exploring some little-known aspects of fashion.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: Shanju is a school, workshops and a group. Cofounded by Judith Zagury, this ambitious project combines circus teaching and work with animals. With a single idea in mind, to give pride of place to the relationship with animals.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: In the heart of the Marais, the Museum of Magic reveals its secrets. Between cinema and pop culture, the couture designer Julien Fournié rolls out his fashion on the red carpet.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: Alexis is exploring his adventurous side and is getting ready for a two-day bikepacking trip, led by Simon Bergeron and Marie-Pierre Savard, two adventure biking enthusiasts.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: In the heart of the Marais district in Paris, the National Archives Museum hosts works dating back several centuries. French designer and architect Hervé Van der Straeten opens the doors to his workshop. Style by Alessandro Michele for Valentino. We meet up with ceramic artist Alison Thirion.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: #VF

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: The jeweller Fred and the famous Paris Ritz reinvent their heritage. Jeans designer Dao re-conquers the world of denim, and Robert Mercier sculpts leather. Texto Dallas creates the nails of the future and hairstylist Charlie Le Mindu dresses the staircase at La Samaritaine with hair.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.desc: Actor, screenwriter, director and member of the Comédie-Française, Guillaume Gallienne has published "Le Buveur de brume", inspired by a night spent in a museum in Georgia. With him, we welcome Bruno Ély, director of the Musée Granet in Aix-en-Provence and a specialist in the painter Paul Cézanne. An artist who Guillaume Gallienne knows well, having portrayed him on the big screen. Victor Obalk tells us all about the Spanish painter Diego Velázquez. Alex Vizorek takes us to Liège, Belgium, for an exhibition devoted to the French photographer Robert Doisneau.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: Through rooms filled with colour, Stefania di Petrillo explores the emotional dimension of design. With Marion Flament the art of stained glass breaks free from its traditional constraints.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: We head off to the Fine Arts Museum in Libourne. Deep dive into sculptor Hugo Servanin's library of bodies and engineering laboratory. Danish designer Cécilie Bahnsen: combining Scandinavian pragmatism with French know-how. Discovery: digital light embroidery by Lou de Pray.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Since the company's earliest days Pierre Frey has symbolised luxury in the world of furnishing fabrics: a reputation based on its unwavering respect for traditional know-how. All about the pretzel. Martres-Tolosane is one of the France's earthenware capitals. How to wear a cardigan for guaranteed style.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: Hugo Lienhard is a model craftsman. After working on scenery for theatre and opera, today he makes impressive miniature archaeological reconstitutions for several museums in French-speaking Switzerland.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: From self-taught to Michelin-starred chef, at Le Grand Véfour Guy Martin looks back over a career in gastronomy. Amandine Antunez masters the art of marble-stucco using plant-based dyes.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: Visit to one of the most beautiful mountain biking sites in Canada: the Bras-du-Nord valley, close to Québec. The quality of its biking trail network and its sustainable tourism model make it a must.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: Visit to the three museums at the Polish Library in Paris. Shapes navigate between imaginary worlds in ceramic artist Clémentine de Chabaneix's universe. Willy Chavarria, American-Mexican designer and activist, shows at the American Cathedral in Paris. Bookbinders and gilders, Nathalie and Christophe Legrand restore books which they cover in light.

programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S09
programme.desc: The Decorative Arts Museum pays tribute to Iris Van Herpen: a look back at the career of an exceptional fashion designer. A rare and creative vision: for Arthur Avellano latex is all. Maison RD, one of the last bastions of Parisian feather-working, revived by the arrival of a gifted designer.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: LA BELLE VIE S03
programme.desc: In Rivi�re-ˆ-Claude, Julien discovers an open-air cooperative set up by Antoine. Totally off-grid ten young adults live there, each participating fully in all the projects: from household tasks to creating a garden.

programme.title: Démo de Mode
programme.desc: We look back at the 2023 Africa Fashion Up, the leading Parisian event for African fashion, in the company of Val_rie Ka, the woman behind its creation, and Fabrice Zaady, guest designer from Cªte d'Ivoire.

programme.title: HABITANTS DU NORD
programme.desc: Inuvik, 3400 inhabitants, is the big town on Dempster Highway. There, Nadia and Vincent discover a church shaped like an igloo and the most northern mosque in the world. While gardening in the community greenhouse, they discuss the cost of life and food.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: Towns and buildings to discover at the Cité de l'Architecture et du Patrimoine. From the kitchens of the greatest chefs to that of the Lucas Carton Paris, the star-studded career of Hugo Bourny. Chemena Kamali takes control at Chloé. Interior decorator, Éloïse d'Argent brings sublime style to ceilings and walls.

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S09
programme.desc: Les Journées Particulières by LVMH: perspectives for the craft professions in the world of fashion. The story of sauerkraut, a journey from China to Alsace. Graphic artist Sarah Naud and her sculptures in cement. How to get the biker look. Dgena Mouclier and upcycled menswear fashion.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.desc: Our first guest is an actress and artist with a passion for drawing, painting and photography... Louise Bourgoin will tell us why art is her refuge and her place of freedom. We're also joined by Dhewadi Hadjab, an artist who has become a key figure, exhibited in some of the biggest galleries, and whose paintings explore the movement of bodies in space. The Vizorek'xpert chronicle: Niki de Saint Phalle as seen by Alex Vizorek.

programme.title: Démo de Mode
programme.desc: Viviane welcomes her first menswear designer! Louis Gabriel Nouchi presents his 2023-2024 autumn-winter collection, inspired by the novel "American Psycho" by Bret Easton Ellis.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: A visit to the Trotting Museum at the Domaine de Grosbois. Worthy heir to the Nabi movement, the painter Nathanaëlle Herbelin invites us into her studio. Adrian Appiolaza is artistic director for Maison Moschino. Nature's organic shapes are omnipresent in the creations of cabinetmaker Maxime Goléo.

programme.title: The King of UFOs

programme.title: Aliens & Demons: Evidence of an Unseen Realm
programme.desc: UFO conventions may not seem like a good place for a Christian theology professor, but that’s where you can sometimes find Dr. Michael Heiser, an Old Testament scholar and author of the book, The Unseen Realm: Recovering the Supernatural Worldview of the Bible. Dr. Heiser's interest in UFO stories has led him to ask intriguing questions like, are all these stories of unidentified objects in the sky and alien abductions merely the product of Science Fiction run amuck or could there be something deeper hidden under the surface? In this provocative documentary, Dr. Michael Heiser explores the unexpected intersection between UFOs, alien abductions, the world of angels and demons, and the ancient texts that speak of them. Approx. 75 minutes.

programme.title: Unveiled
programme.desc: Embark on an enthralling journey with "Unveiled," a captivating TV series exploring the enigmatic world of aliens, UFOs, conspiracy theories, and extraterrestrial history. Each episode unveils astonishing encounters, hidden truths, and thought-provoking revelations that challenge reality itself. Discover a thrilling blend of scientific exploration, historical analysis, and captivating storytelling as "Unveiled" pushes the boundaries of human understanding and leaves audiences captivated by the mysteries of the universe.

programme.desc: Dark Magic has traditionally referred to the use of supernatural powers for evil or magic associated with the devil. This documentary examines the history and occult practices of Dark Magic.

programme.desc: UFO conventions may not seem like a good place for a Christian theology professor, but that’s where you can sometimes find Dr. Michael Heiser, an Old Testament scholar and author of the book, The Unseen Realm: Recovering the Supernatural Worldview of the Bible. Dr. Heiser's interest in UFO stories has led him to ask intriguing questions like, are all these stories of unidentified objects in the sky and alien abductions merely the product of Science Fiction run amuck or could there be something deeper hidden under the surface? In this provocative documentary, Dr. Michael Heiser explores the unexpected intersection between UFOs, alien abductions, the world of angels and demons, and the ancient texts that speak of them. Approx. 75 minutes.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked
programme.desc: Enter a world where craftsmanship meets art at a microscopic level. For the first time ever, high-definition cameras equipped with super-macro lenses reveal the inner workings of some of the most delicate and exquisite timepieces ever created. Two-thousand-year-old-bones may be evidence, never before seen, of an actual crucifixion from the time of Jesus. They may reveal that the classic depiction of Jesus on the cross is not how crucifixions were actually carried out in the 1st Century.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked
programme.desc: A recently discovered Dead Sea Scrolls fragment may be the oldest reference to Jesus ever found. It may have been written in Aramaic by some of his earliest disciples. Outside the ancient city of Jericho there is evidence that the same Roman Army that oppressed Christians may have been secretly worshipping Jesus.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked
programme.desc: The eruption of Vesuvius may have been the catalyst for the spread of Christianity in the Roman Empire. Have archeologists found the earliest reference to "Christians" in Pompeii? How did our current alphabet evolve? Perhaps from adaptations of Egyptian hierogylphics? How did the symbols become associated with sounds? Travel from Toronto to Serabit El Kadim in Egypt as we look for answers to how we got to our 26 letter alphabet.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked
programme.desc: There are literally hundreds of food references in the Bible, but the Bible lists ingredients - not recipes. Learn how to make olive oil as they did in ancient times and find out more about the meat, grains and beans eaten in biblical times and how they were prepared. There is new evidence to suggest that the cross was used as a symbol of Christianity far earlier than the time of Constantine. Excavations in Herculaneum and Bethsaida tell a new story about the adoption of the cross as a representation of faith.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked
programme.desc: Around 733 B.C., ten of the twelve tribes of Israel were conquered and exiled by the Assyrian Empire. Where did the Gadarenes of Gadara go when they were exiled? Can we trace them through to the 21st Century in Europe? Is there any archeological proof for the tradition that Christ carried his cross and stopped in certain locations on the way to Calvary? We follow The Stations Of The Cross to find out what traces may remain in present-day Jerusalem.

programme.title: 10 Kilos in the Trunk

programme.title: Messy
